name: NUSE
description: Veteran heavy metal band formed in Hillsborough in the 1990s, now a four-piece with Mike LaMastro, brothers Eric and Bob Mangual, and Mike Wilday. Their catalog runs from the early-2000s debut Hung Well to the Evilution EP series.
activity: Released the Evilution Vol. 2 EP with lead single "Malibu" around July 2025 (covered Aug 11, 2025). A Patch piece also notes them as 95.9 The Rat's Jersey Rock Band of the Week.

name: Black Cordova
description: Instrumental guitar act from Hillsborough Township playing surf, spooky soundtrack-style and theme-music rock. It releases through Lump'N'Loaf Records, a Central Jersey musicians' collective.
activity: Released the single "Theme from Lady Grimoire" on Bandcamp on Oct 27, 2025.

name: Bryan Hansen Band
description: Rock-and-funk band led by guitarist-singer Bryan Hansen, based in his hometown of Somerville. Their album Jammin with Dr. Fong includes the single "Death of a Yes Man" with guest Jeff Coffin, and they have played Somerville's Division Street summer stage.
activity: WEAK: Bandsintown listed an Apr 17, 2025 show at Hailey's Harp & Pub in Metuchen under the band's name, but it was billed as a solo acoustic set. Their own site lists no upcoming shows. The Somerville base comes from a 2023 New Jersey Stage article.
